key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A inhibitors (ketoconazole, itraconazole, clarithromycin, nefazodone, nelfinavir, ritonavir)
Moderate CYP3A inhibitors (diltiazem, verapamil, erythromycin, fluconazole); grapefruit
key_interactions.action: Limit ranolazine to 500 mg twice daily.
With ranolazine 1,000 mg twice daily, limit metformin to 1,700 mg daily.
Limit simvastatin to 20 mg; doses of narrow-range CYP3A substrates may need reduction.
Reduced doses may be needed; monitor.
